text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to nail SDK + docs acceptance criteria for the upcoming API surface changes (structured output + function calling + embeddings/rerank examples). Customers (Acme, NovaHealth) flagged typed examples as blocker.

samir: agree. main hitch: function calling shapes differ between models (name+args vs typed schema). Need TS types + runtime validators for Python.

zoe: propose checklist:
- TS types (index.d.ts)
- Python dataclasses/pydantic examples
- runnable examples for chat+function, embeddings, rerank
- changelog entry + migration notes
- one canary sample app

alex: priority wise: customer-blocking > internal nice-to-have. timeline: 2-week sprint for minimal, 4 weeks for polished. can we scope M1?

luis: M1 = minimal typed surface + 2 examples (chat with function call, embeddings pipeline) + changelog. M2 = structured-output guide + rerank deep dive + sample app.

samir: for TS snippet, we can expose types like:
```ts
type FunctionSchema = {
  name: string;
  arguments: { [k: string]: string };
}
```
and usage:
```ts
client.chat.create({ model, messages, functions })
```

maya: docs note: include code samples for migration from v1->v2, highlight breaking changes and deprecation windows.

zoe: I can own the docs PR if eng provides code examples + type defs. Can we get a gated checklist in the PR template? e.g., add `SDK types done`, `Examples runnable`, `Changelog` checkboxes.

alex: also want metrics for launch: at least one paying customer using new examples OR nps>0 on docs survey. Add telemetry event for sample-run.

docs-bot: reminder: changelog template at /docs/.changelog-template.md — use conventional commits and include "migration" section.

luis: action items:
- eng: deliver TS type + Python dataclass example by EOD Tue (samir)
- docs: draft PR template + initial pages by Thu (zoe)
- product: create customer comms + canary plan (alex)
I'll ping again Friday.

samir: ack, will post gists when ready.

maya: thanks all — will compile acceptance criteria and publish to roadmap board. :thumbsup:
